title: Mistoholdings stock drops over 9% as operating profit misses market expectations : Finance : JKN

 🌐 한국어 · 日本語 · 中文 · हिन्दी · Español · العربية · Français · বাংলা · Русский · Deutsch Yoon Geun-il Reporter 입력 2026.11.16 16:15 ( 연합뉴스 ) Shares of Misto Holdings, which owns the sports brand Fila, fell by more than 9% in early trading on the 16th. The decline is attributed to a decrease in third-quarter operating and net profits, as well as operating profit falling short of market expectations.
 Stock Price Plummets After Quarterly Earnings Report
 Misto Holdings showed a downward trend on the KOSPI market at 9:31 a.m. that day. Its third-quarter earnings, released on the 13th, acted as a burden on investor sentiment.
 Misto Holdings' third-quarter operating profit was 128 billion won, down 3.0% from the same period last year. It also fell short of the market expectation of 144.2 billion won. Net profit decreased by 23.5% to 78 billion won.
 Revenue Increased, But Profitability Declined
 Third-quarter revenue was 1.1254 trillion won, an increase of 3.4% compared to the same period last year. Although the company grew in size, the decline in operating and net profits did not lead to improved profitability.
 Compared to the previous quarter, revenue for the third quarter decreased by 21.4% and operating profit by 56.7%. Although quarterly performance was sluggish, the cumulative operating profit for the first three quarters of this year was 616.9 billion won, up 29.5% from the same period last year. Cumulative revenue was 3.8456 trillion won, and cumulative net profit was 444.8 billion won, an increase of 8.2% and 13.3%, respectively.
 Securities Industry: “Investment for Greater China Business”
 Ryu Eun-ae, a researcher at KB Securities, stated, "The third-quarter results fell below market expectations as costs for growth were executed amidst a slowdown in domestic demand," adding, "However, this was in the nature of an investment for the full-scale launch of business in the Greater China region next year, and existing brands also showed solid growth."
 KB Securities maintained its 'buy' investment rating for Misto Holdings and maintained its target stock price at 57,000 won.
